mutations.note: jq-del-3 speaks of a consumer, a message and a visibility window; everywhere else these are a worker, a job and a lease.

edits.with: - **`jq-del-3`**: A consumer confirms a message by calling `Ack(receipt)` before the visibility window closes. A confirmed message MUST be deleted and MUST NOT be delivered again.

mutations.note: jq-enq-1 rejects payloads outside 'the sizes given in Definitions', but the payload definition no longer gives a size.
'Delivered reliably' replaces the at-least-once guarantee and its end conditions.
jq-fail-3 speaks of a 5-minute lease; the definition says 30 seconds.

edits.with: - **`jq-fail-3`**: A worker that needs longer than the 5-minute lease MUST split its work into smaller jobs.
